subtitle: Lesson 15 · The Real Fix, Proven Across Every Provider

eyebrow: A diagnostic tool, not a fix

steps.label: Resets the sniffed value
steps.sub: Doesn't stop sniffing from happening again

code:
ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.usp_GetProviderSchedule @ProviderID int AS
SELECT a.AppointmentID, a.AppointmentDate, p.FirstName, p.LastName
FROM dbo.Appointments a
JOIN dbo.Patients p ON p.PatientID = a.PatientID
WHERE a.ProviderID = @ProviderID
OPTION (RECOMPILE);
caption: A fresh plan every execution — no sniffed plan ever reused.

code:
EXEC dbo.usp_GetProviderSchedule @ProviderID = 4;    -- small
EXEC dbo.usp_GetProviderSchedule @ProviderID = 55;   -- mid-size
EXEC dbo.usp_GetProviderSchedule @ProviderID = 112;  -- large
caption: Timings stay consistent no matter which order they run in.
